title: 第一卷 第3章 今时不同往日第一卷 第4章 大小姐秦明岚
slug: 逆主马奴我以阴阳证大道
lines: “你……怎么可能？！”
洛寒衣浑身一震，她亲自吸干了这个老奴的阳气，即便是壮实中年，也得虚弱三日，他……
王龙坐起身来，长长地吐出一口浊气。
他感受到脑海中那柄诛仙剑胚，虽然不能拿出来，却隐隐有种与它心神相连的感觉，一缕锐利的剑气在其中孕养。
至于太虚破妄剑诀，一招一式，清晰刻印在脑海之中。
王龙抬起头，看向洛寒衣。
洛寒衣也死死盯着他，暗中凝聚真气。
她想到方才被这个男人羞辱，驰骋……
想到自己的主动摇曳……
洛寒衣抬起玉手，就要一掌拍下！
可就在真气运转的一瞬间，她愣住了，玉手僵在半空，眼神复杂异常。
只是一夜双修，十年来未曾松动的桎梏，竟被捅破了。
洛寒衣咬了咬嘴唇，眼神冰冷，却又带着一丝说不清道不明的深意。
她想到了侯府处境，想到了自己在外求学的女儿……
群狼虎豹，频频试探，那些势力，供奉中不乏六品、甚至七品的武道强者。
【武者境界：一到九品，九品之上则为大宗师。（大乾宗师不过五指之数）】
传闻皇室的大供奉，就是一位大宗师。
洛寒衣一个六品初期的寡妇，难以护住这偌大的侯府。
她需要更强的力量。
而这肮脏老奴……或就是机缘所在。
若能破镜七品，那么侯府的地位将更加稳固，女儿的前途也会更有保障。
洛寒衣眼神闪烁下，手缓缓放了下来。
她站在床边，居高临下地看着王龙，眼中的杀意已经散去，取而代之的是冷静的审视。
当年，亡夫还在时，他们夫妻二人就是靠双修功法，在短短数年内突破至五品。
可这门功法有个致命的缺陷。
它需要男女双方同时修炼，心意相通，阴阳调和。
一旦一方身死，另一方轻则修为停滞，重则——
功法反噬！
十年来，她尝尽了反噬之苦。
每一次发作都是烈火焚身，痛不欲生。
而那卑贱肮脏的老奴，不仅安抚了她的反噬，甚至还安抚了她十年来的空白。
哼！
定是他攒了六十八年的缘故，如若不然，岂能有那般恐怖的爆发力和持久力？
想到这，洛寒衣的眼神变得幽深。
那种感觉，夫君没有给过，夫君走后，自娱自乐的快感，更是不及一分一毫。
没有任何修为，甚至连真气都没有……却是让她一举破镜……
若是让他跟着自己修炼这功法，问鼎七品也不无可能……
洛寒衣从指尖的储物戒指中取出《阴阳合欢诀》的卷轴。
“此功法，你好好研习！”
content_en:
"You...how is that possible?!"
Luo Hanyi was shocked. She personally drained the old slave's yang energy. Even a strong middle-aged man had to be weak for three days. He...
Wang Long sat up and exhaled a long breath.
He felt the embryo of the Immortal Killing Sword in his mind. Although he could not take it out, he felt vaguely connected to it, and a sharp sword energy was nurtured in it.
As for the Taixu Breaking the Illusion Sword Technique, each move is clearly engraved in my mind.
Wang Long raised his head and looked at Luo Hanyi.
Luo Hanyi also stared at him, secretly gathering his energy.
She thought of being humiliated by this man just now, galloping...
Thinking of my own initiative wavering...
Luo Hanyi raised his jade hand and was about to slap it down with one palm!
But at the moment when her true energy was circulating, she froze, her jade hands froze in mid-air, and her eyes were extremely complicated.
Just one night of double cultivation, the shackles that had not been loosened for ten years were actually broken.
Luo Hanyi bit his lip, his eyes cold, but with a hint of unexplainable meaning.
She thought of the situation in the Hou Mansion and her daughter who was studying abroad...
A group of wolves, tigers and leopards frequently tested them. Among those forces, there were many sixth-grade or even seventh-grade martial arts masters enshrined.
[Martial artist realm: one to nine levels, and those above nine levels are great masters. (Grandmaster Daqian can only be counted on five fingers)]
It is said that the great enshrined person of the royal family is a great master.
Luo Hanyi, a widow in the early stage of the sixth rank, could not protect such a large Hou Mansion.
She needs more strength.
And this dirty old slave... may be where the opportunity lies.
If he can break the seventh level of the mirror, then the status of the Hou family will be more stable, and his daughter's future will be more secure.
Luo Hanyi's eyes flickered and he slowly lowered his hand.
She stood by the bed and looked down at Wang Long. The murderous intent in her eyes had dissipated and was replaced by a calm look.
Back then, when the late husband was still alive, the couple relied on dual cultivation of Kung Fu to break through to the fifth level in just a few years.
But this technique has a fatal flaw.
It requires both men and women to practice at the same time, with minds connected and yin and yang harmonious.
Once one party dies, the other party's cultivation will at least stagnate, or at worst -
The technique backfires!
In the past ten years, she has experienced all kinds of backlash.
Every time an attack occurs, the body is burned with burning pain, and the pain is unbearable.
And that mean and dirty old slave not only appeased her backlash, but even appeased her ten years of blankness.
snort!
It must be because he has been saving for sixty-eight years. If not, how could he have such terrifying explosive power and endurance?
Thinking of this, Luo Hanyi's eyes became dark.
Her husband never gave her that kind of feeling, and after her husband left, the pleasure of entertaining herself was even less than one cent.
She didn't have any cultivation, not even her true energy... but it made her break the mirror in one fell swoop...
If he were allowed to practice this technique with him, it would be impossible to aspire to the seventh rank...
Luo Hanyi took out the scroll of "Yin Yang Jue Huan Jue" from the storage ring on his fingertips.
"You should study this technique carefully!"
